posts.text:
Deployment of the week: wall-climbing robots inspecting ADNOC's energy facilities.

▸ Who: Gecko Robotics with ADNOC, plus a new ADNOC Onshore agreement
▸ What it does: the Raptor robot climbs tanks, pipes and boiler walls and maps wall thickness with ultrasound, so people don't have to work at height or inside assets
▸ Scale: tens of machines running daily in the UAE
▸ Why it matters: after a year of damage to Gulf energy infrastructure, inspection robots are being bought as infrastructure, not as pilots

It's one of 4 inspection deployments in our database. Full record and our ADIPEC analysis in the comments.

#Robotics #Energy #UAE #Inspection

posts.text:
The biggest robot buyer in the Middle East isn't logistics or oil and gas. It's hospitals.

Of the 66 verified deployments in our database, 17 are in healthcare: surgical robots in Riyadh, Kuwait's public hospitals, AKDITAL's network in Morocco, and now Egypt's planned da Vinci pilots.

Construction and logistics follow with 10 each. Mobility (robotaxis and autonomous shuttles) has 7.

What this means: the region's buyers are already used to paying for capital-heavy robots with long procurement cycles. That's useful context for anyone selling here.

The sector filter is in the database. Link in the comments.

#Robotics #Healthcare #MENA #MedTech

posts.text:
5 robotics signals from MENA in the past fortnight, each verified at the source:

1. Egypt plans da Vinci robotic-surgery pilots in public hospitals with Sofmedica
2. NAVER sets H1 2027 for NURI delivery robots in Riyadh housing complexes
3. X-GEN becomes Pudu's first partner in Africa and brings drone docks to Egypt
4. Vodafone Qatar signs an MoU to deploy AgiBot embodied-AI robots
5. Dubai gets its first humanoid robot showroom: buy from Dh50,000, rent from under Dh5,000

The pattern: robots are moving from trade-show stands into procurement, with pilots, partner networks and rental models.

Sources in the carousel. The brief comes out every Monday; link in the comments.

#Robotics #MENA #Egypt #Qatar #SaudiArabia

posts.title: Welcome to r/RoboticsMENA, plus the past fortnight: Egypt's robotic-surgery pilots, NAVER's Riyadh delivery robots, and 3 more
posts.text:
Hi all. This community is for robots, drones, autonomous vehicles and physical AI doing real work across the Middle East & North Africa. I run roboticsmena.com, a free database where every deployment has a source and a date, so I'll post what we verify here every week. Please add what we miss.

**The past fortnight (6 to 12 Nov):**

- **Egypt:** the health ministry plans da Vinci robotic-surgery pilots in public hospitals with Sofmedica ([Maspero](https://www.maspero.eg/science-and-technology/2026/11/12/1005059/))
- **Saudi Arabia:** NAVER says its NURI delivery robots launch commercially in Riyadh housing complexes in H1 2027 ([Seoul Economic Daily](https://en.sedaily.com/business/2026/11/12/naver-to-launch-outdoor-delivery-robots-in-saudi-arabia))
- **Egypt:** X-GEN becomes Pudu's first partner in Africa ([TechAfrica News](https://techafricanews.com/2026/11/11/egypt-x-gen-three-deals-robotics-drone-technologies/))
- **Qatar:** Vodafone Qatar and AgiBot sign an embodied-AI MoU ([QNA](https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/8/vodafone-qatar-agibot-sign-mou-to-explore-deploying-embodied-ai-robotics-solutions))
- **UAE:** Lootah Robotics opens a humanoid showroom on Sheikh Zayed Road; rentals from under Dh5,000 ([The National](https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/06/uae-opens-its-first-humanoid-robotics-showroom-as-dubai-races-to-200000-robots/))

What else happened in your country? Comments in Arabic are welcome too.

posts.title: [OC] 66 verified robot deployments across MENA: hospitals are the biggest buyer, not oil and gas
posts.text:
We counted every deployment in our database that has a primary source and a date (66 so far).

**By sector:** healthcare 17, construction 10, logistics 10, mobility 7, retail 5, hospitality 4, energy 4.

**By country:** UAE 26, Saudi Arabia 17, Egypt 6, Qatar 5, Oman 4, Morocco 2, Jordan 2, and one each in Bahrain, Algeria, Kuwait and Tunisia.

Two caveats: English and Arabic sources are easier for us to find than French ones, so the Maghreb is probably under-counted. And a deployment can be one surgical robot or a fleet of 70 robotaxis.

What surprises you here? What are we missing in Morocco, Tunisia and Algeria?

(The data is at roboticsmena.com/database if you want to check or correct a record.)

posts.title: Which robot have you actually seen working in the region, in person?
posts.text:
Not a demo at an expo. A robot doing a real job: a cleaning robot in a mall, a delivery robot, a robotaxi, a surgical robot at your hospital, a drone doing inspections.

Where was it, and did it work well? We'll check the good ones and add them to the map (with credit if you want it).
